ARC-CO rate = lesser of (guarantee revenue minus actual revenue, floored at zero) and the maximum payment rate (12% of benchmark revenue). Actual revenue = county yield x projected national price. “Combined” uses the all-practice rate, or the simple average of irrigated and non-irrigated rates where a county is split. Irrigated and non-irrigated yields are imputed from the NASS county yield using the county’s benchmark ratio. Total payment = rate x 2025 FSA enrolled ARC-CO base acres x 85%; for counties with irrigated and non-irrigated rows it uses their average rate, which assumes equal acreage. Grey counties have no 2025 NASS county or state “other counties” yield, or no ARC-CO record for the crop. Rates are before sequestration, payment limits and the 85% payment factor on base acres.
